The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rama' which means 'pleasing' or 'delight'. These warriors were part of the royal armies and were highly revered for their martial skills.

Another reference suggests that Ramsh was a title given to Hindu saints and spiritual leaders in ancient India. These individuals were revered for their deep spiritual knowledge and inner peace. The name 'Ramsh' is believed to be derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rama' which means 'God' or 'Divine'.
